items.name: Greater Healing Potion
items.desc: A thick red draught that closes wounds fast. Works mid-fight.

items.name: Giant's Brew
items.desc: Bitter and strong. Raises your strength and toughness for a few rounds.

items.name: Boots of Haste
items.desc: Cover more ground before the dark notices you. Grants extra actions.

items.name: Oracle Bones
items.desc: Cast them to see four possible paths and choose which one comes true.

items.name: Gambler's Die
items.desc: Roll it before you swing — your next attacks are made with advantage.

items.name: Antivenom Vial
items.desc: Purges every lingering ailment from your blood.

items.name: Recall Stone
items.desc: Snaps you back to the level entrance in an instant.

items.name: Wyrmtooth Blade
items.desc: Serrated dragon fang. Bites deep and leaves the wound bleeding.

enemies.name: Cave Troll
enemies.flavor: Enormous, slow, and extremely annoyed that you're here.

enemies.name: Corpse Wisp
enemies.flavor: A cold light that drifts just out of reach.

traps.name: Rune Snare
traps.flavor: Old glyphs flare underfoot and clamp shut.
